title: rhamnus cathartica subsp. hydriensis
intro: Rhamnus cathartica subsp. hydriensis, commonly known as Hydrangea buckthorn, is a plant species within the Rhamnaceae family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues and skin problems, thanks to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rhamnus cathartica subsp. hydriensis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which can aid in soothing irritated skin and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its potential therapeutic effects.
